# Financial statements (RDF, manual mode)

Copies of files downloaded manually from https://rdf-przegladarka.ms.gov.pl/ on 31.10.2026 (shared with the sister project okiemnaolawe). Changes from the originals: electronic signature elements (`ds:Signature`, personal certificates) and attachment contents (`Zawartosc`, base64 PDF) removed. The remaining content (header, balance sheet, income statement, cash flows) is unchanged.

| File | Company, year | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `zwik-2025-esprawozdanie.xml` | ZWiK Oława, 2025 | income statement by function, indirect cash flows; control values: revenue 40,122,668.01 PLN, net result 1,803,481.99 PLN, capital expenditure (B.II.1) 1,891,014.21 PLN; `OkresOd` in the file is 2025-01-31 |
| `termy-2024-esprawozdanie.xml` | Termy Jakuba, 2024 | income statement by nature, no cash-flow statement; revenue 6,261,864.73 PLN, net result −822,987.55 PLN |
| `mzec-2025-esprawozdanie-koperta-dokumentu.xml` | MZEC Oława, 2025 | inside a document envelope; income statement by nature, no cash flows; revenue 17,944,916.28 PLN, net result 307,749.63 PLN |
